# EarthRef.org

> A comprehensive digital repository and research platform for Earth sciences data, geochemical databases, oceanographic archives, and educational resources.

EarthRef.org serves the geosciences community by hosting major databases like GERM (geochemical reference data), seamount catalogs, paleomagnetic datasets, and educational initiatives. The platform includes the ERDA digital archive with video seminars, research data, and geomagnetic field models.

## Key Topics

- Paleomagnetism
- Geomagnetic field
- Rock magnetism
- Digital archive
- GERM database
- Seamount research
- Earth magnetism
- Paleomagnetic data
- Geochemical databases
- MagNetZ seminars
- Apparent polar wander
- Geomagnetic reversals
- Environmental magnetism
- Educational resources
- Oceanographic data

## Core Research Databases

- [Geochemical Earth Reference Model (GERM)](https://earthref.org/GERM): Comprehensive geochemical databases for Earth reservoirs and partition coefficients.
- [Seamount Biogeosciences Network (SBN)](https://earthref.org/SBN): Seamount catalog and digital archive for oceanographic and geological data.
- [Fe-Oxidizing Microbial Observatory (FeMO)](https://earthref.org/FEMO): Microbial observatory studying iron-oxidizing bacteria at Loihi Seamount.

## Educational Resources

- [Enduring Resources for Earth Sciences Education (ERESE)](https://earthref.org/ERESE): Educational resources and materials for Earth sciences teaching.
- [Scripps Classroom Connection](https://earthref.org/SCC): K-12 partnership for Earth science education through Scripps Institution.

## Paleomagnetic Data & Models

- [LN3' Miocene Geomagnetic Field Model](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2769): Miocene geomagnetic field model with Gauss coefficients.
- [MTAM1 Miocene Time-Averaged Geomagnetic Field Model](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2768): Miocene time-averaged geomagnetic field model.
- [Joint Inference of Core Field and Surface Flow](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2776): Paleomagnetic data and Bayesian inference for core field modeling.
- [Reversal Frequency Models Using Adaptive-Bandwidth Kernel Density Estimation](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2772): Geomagnetic reversal frequency models and paleomagnetic statistical methods.
- [Quantifying P-T Conditions of Silica-Enrichment in Archean Cratonic Spinel-Facies Peri](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2774): Archean petrology and thermobarometry data from Kaapvaal craton.

## MagNetZ Seminar Series

- [MagNetZ: Apparent Polar Wander (Douwe van Hinsbergen)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2778): Paleomagnetism seminar video on apparent polar wander.
- [MagNetZ: Geomagnetic Field and Rock Magnetism (Joe Kirschvink)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2777): Seminar video on geomagnetic field and rock magnetism.
- [MagNetZ: Paleomagnetism and Cretaceous Geology (Augusto Rapalini)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2775): Seminar on paleomagnetism and Cretaceous geology.
- [MagNetZ: Paleomagnetism and Rock Magnetism (Joe Stoner)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2773): Seminar video on paleomagnetism and rock magnetism.
- [MagNetZ: Environmental Magnetism and Climate Records (Christian Ohneiser)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2771): Seminar on environmental magnetism and climate records.
- [MagNetZ: Machine Learning for Paleomagnetism (Facundo Sapienza)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2770): Seminar on machine learning for paleomagnetism.
- [MagNetZ: Paleomagnetism and Paleoenvironment (Romina Achaga)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2767): Seminar on paleomagnetism and paleoenvironment.
- [MagNetZ: Paleointensity Estimation Methods (Kaixian Qi)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2766): Seminar on paleointensity estimation methods.
- [MagNetZ: Archeomagnetic Studies and South Atlantic Anomaly (Yoseph Dres)](http://earthref.org/ERDA/2765): Seminar on archeomagnetic studies and South Atlantic anomaly.
